chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
The protected area of a palm tree is the length of its fronds.

key_terms.حَرِيمُ: the protected or reserved area attached to property or a resource
key_terms.رَسُولُ: Messenger; here, the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: What is the legal protected area around a palm tree in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal measure for the protected area surrounding a palm tree. It defines the harim of the tree according to the extent of its fronds, indicating a juristic principle related to property boundaries and usage rights.
